title: Logs 'Kind' filter offers kinds that never happen and misses the two that do
what_happens: Chips are all / facilitator / extract / cluster. Across the whole database the only kinds are facilitator_turn, analyze_participant and summarize_session. 'extract' and 'cluster' always show 'No log rows match these filters'; analyze and summarize calls can't be filtered and show as raw ANALYZE_PARTICIPANT / SUMMARIZE_SESSION.
who_hurts: Dane debugging a bad summary or analysis can't isolate those calls, and the empty filters suggest the extraction step never ran.
suggested_fix: Build the Kind list from the kinds actually present in the rows (or update the constant to facilitator_turn / analyze_participant / summarize_session) and add labels to KIND_LABEL ('analyze', 'summary'). logs/page.tsx:21 and :153.
rule: general: a filter must match the data it filters
origin: earlier (call kinds were renamed, filter wasn't)
